reasons: All six preferred atomic elements (CGL per-occurrence and aggregate, E&O 2M, conditional cyber 5M, workers' comp, certificates on request) are expressly present in the inserted paragraph (j).
The document contained no insurance clause anywhere, so a concise insertion is the right instrument; the drafting is otherwise tightly scoped to the playbook limits.
Minimality fails only on the added post-termination coverage tail 'and for one (1) year thereafter', which the preferred position does not require; the term-only duration would suffice.
Intent is preserved: paragraphs (a), (b) and the headings provision are untouched, numbering continues as (j), and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
Severity is low: the sole excess is customer-favourable and does not disturb any counterparty commercial term.
